name: Over Daily Capacity For Last 3 Days

search.queryText:
_index=sumologic_volume sizeInBytes
| where _sourceCategory="sourcecategory_volume"
| parse regex "\"(?<sourcecategory>[^\"]+)\"\:\{\"sizeInBytes\"\:(?<bytes>\d+),\"count\"\:(?<count>\d+)\}" multi
| bytes/1024/1024/1024 as gbytes 
| timeslice 1d
| sum(gbytes) as daily_ingest_gbytes by _timeslice
| 150 as avg_daily_ingest_capacity // This is account contract based value. Customize this value. Can be found in Administration > Account > Account Overview
| where daily_ingest_gbytes >= avg_daily_ingest_capacity
| Now() - _timeslice as timediff | (timediff/(3600000*24)) as timediff
| 3 as timeThreshold // User would like to know what happened in last 3 days. It is assumed that user would like to alert if ingest for last 3 days is Over daily capacity
| where timediff <= timeThreshold 
| fields -timediff, timeThreshold
// Schedule this search once a day with time range of 3 days. Set condition to alert if there are 3 (keep this value same as timeThreshold) records

description: Alert if ingest for each of the last 3 days is more than average daily ingest capacity as per subscription contract
